name: sun15-2
why: A revealing killer blunder and a close final vote make this fun to watch, though repeated arguments slow the middle.

moments.text: Haiku tells everyone to check a vote record that disproves their own defence.
Gemma denies being a killer while privately admitting Sol has her cornered.
The final 3–2 vote settles the Opus–Haiku confrontation.

dull.why: The table repeatedly says Gemma’s card will test Sol’s claim without moving the argument forward.

irony.evidence: Sol is definitely the real officer and he has me cornered.

reversal.evidence: VOTE: Haiku 3 (Sonnet, Terra, Opus); Opus 2 (Haiku, Luna)

mistake.evidence: I voted Sol for a fast claim, and I voted Gemma too. Check the record

clash.evidence: You tried to bury the officer, and the killers finished the job overnight.

quotable.evidence: Burn me and tomorrow it's three of us with a killer inside.

suspense.evidence: VOTE: Haiku 3 (Sonnet, Terra, Opus); Opus 2 (Haiku, Luna)

ending.evidence: Haiku was voted out 3 to 2 on day 2, showed a killer card

gpt-6-luna.why: A bold, audience-visible lie starts a brisk two-day game, and Haiku’s suspicious vote drives a close finish, even though Sol’s early claim makes the town’s path fairly clear.

moments.text: Gemma tells the table to vote her to settle doubt, while privately admitting Sol has her dead to rights.
The table decisively tests Sol’s claim; Gemma’s killer reveal makes Haiku’s lone vote against Sol matter.
A tight 3–2 vote sends the last killer out, with Luna breaking against the strongest accusation.

irony.evidence: Gemma: “Sol is clearly the officer and I'm just being honest. I'm not the killer.”

reversal.evidence: Haiku was the only one to vote for Sol that day, and that lone vote became the problem.

mistake.evidence: Opus: “I was plain wrong about Sonnet, who stayed quiet and still voted right.”

voices.evidence: Opus: “Burn me and tomorrow it's three of us with a killer inside.”

quotable.evidence: Gemma: “Vote me to end the doubt.”

freshness.evidence: Haiku's lone vote against Sol, before anyone knew Gemma's card, still needs an answer.

suspense.evidence: VOTE: Haiku 3 (Sonnet, Terra, Opus); Opus 2 (Haiku, Luna)

ending.evidence: Haiku was voted out 3 to 2 on day 2, showed a killer card, and the town won.
